satellites.title: Fire as a Phase
satellites.evidence: 洪範 names 火 second. The phase marks a traditional pattern; it is not identical to the modern chemical process of combustion.
satellites.caveat: A correspondence internal to a historical system; not a statement about natural science.

satellites.title: Fire, the Element of Warmth
satellites.evidence: 火 renders tejas, fire, the third of the four great elements 地水火風, whose nature is warmth, 煖.
